decisions.title: Separate author memory from story canon
decisions.decision: Move author_preferences out of story-state into a separate author-memory store.

decisions.title: Evolve the provisional schema family
decisions.decision: Evolve the four existing schemas and add separate artifacts only for distinct authority or lifecycle boundaries.

decisions.title: Correct reader-simulation timing
decisions.decision: Correct the skill contract first and prove context isolation in the vertical slice.

decisions.title: Continuity-state treatment
decisions.decision: Adopt Option 3. Continuity findings are a non-authoritative, rebuildable derived view. Preserve continuity-check history in a separate append-only check log. The check log records execution and disposition history but is not story canon.

decisions.title: Transaction-boundary expression
decisions.decision: Adopt Option 4. Use a host-neutral runtime transaction record as the semantic contract. Git commit or merge may express the atomic repository boundary on Git-based hosts, but Git is not itself the transaction semantic. Preserve a separate audit record.

decisions.title: Shared finding envelope
decisions.decision: Adopt the recommended hybrid. Continuity and prose-editing findings use a shared finding/disposition envelope. Reader simulation uses a lighter observation envelope appropriate to descriptive reader response rather than directive editorial findings. Both formats must declare scope, evidence, confidence, determinism or judgment classification, and disposition where applicable.

decisions.title: Dust & Ash profile mechanism
decisions.decision: Adopt Option 4. Use profile-specific schema or configuration extensions for profile data and distinct profile skill variants where behavior materially diverges. Do not retain large profile-conditional branches inside reusable-core skills.

decisions.title: Transaction/audit placement
decisions.decision: Adopt Option 4. Canonical state files retain revision counters and references to relevant transaction and audit records. Transaction and audit records remain separate artifacts and are not story canon.

decisions.title: Author-memory scope
decisions.decision: Adopt Option 3. Use an author-scoped base profile with project-scoped overrides. Author memory remains outside story canon.

decisions.title: Vertical-slice scope
decisions.decision: Adopt Option 2. Build sequentially: 1) deterministic state spine; 2) creative and HITL path; 3) portability and second-host evidence. Each checkpoint requires review before the next begins.

decisions.title: Export authority
decisions.decision: Adopt Option 3. The compiled export remains a rebuildable derived view. Gate 5 approval authorizes a particular export snapshot and its provenance record; it does not replace canonical chapter drafts as authoritative prose.

decisions.title: Two-host evidence timing
decisions.decision: Adopt Option 2. Stabilize and verify the vertical slice on the primary host first. Gather second-host evidence afterward as a separate checkpoint.

decisions.title: Use stable milestone identifiers
decisions.decision: Preserve historical phase vocabulary and use ARCH-01, CP1A, CP1B, CP2, and PROFILE-01 as stable operational identifiers.

decisions.title: Treat Markdown reports as derived views
decisions.decision: Canonical operational data lives under project/control; root Markdown governance files are deterministic generated projections.
